text:
kevin_fin: FYI Skyline Analytics opened a dispute (TKT-7788). Sales applied SUMMER_PARTNER_2026 to the parent account instead of the subsidiary (account: Skyline-APAC). Subsidiary got charged. Need a manual split: $3,000 immediate credit to the subsidiary invoice + $500 goodwill to apply on next invoice. Can we approve?

nora_csm: ouch. can you paste the subsidiary invoice lines so billing has SKUs?

kevin_fin: sure, invoice excerpt below:
```
Invoice 85432 (Skyline-APAC)
- Reserved pool (SKY-RESV-SUB): $8,000
- Usage overage (SKY-USG): $1,200
- Promo applied: $0 (should have had SUMMER_PARTNER_2026)
Total due: $9,200
```

lucas_billing: confirmed the parent invoice 85430 shows a $4,000 promo credit. Looks like promo mapped at account-level instead of subaccount. We need: CM for $3,000 applying to 85432, and a separate memo for $500 goodwill earmarked for next billing cycle. Which GLs?

kevin_fin: allocation: $3,000 corrective credit = reversal (contra-revenue) to GL 5105. $500 goodwill = marketing/promotional credit GL 5135. Tag reason = "MISAPPLIED_PROMO_SPLIT_TKT-7788".

sara_cfo: okay to make the customer whole. Approve $3,000 immediate + $500 goodwill. Please note revenue recognition impact: immediate credit reduces recognized revenue if in same period; if goodwill applies next month tag it for month-end review. Include short justification: "Promo misapplied at account level; moved per customer request; TKT-7788." :white_check_mark:

sales-ops: we'll remind AEs to set promo scope to subaccount where required and add a billing cutoff checklist item.

billing-bot: Credit memo CM-2026-0580 created for $3,000 against invoice 85432. Reissued invoice: 85432-R1 (net due $6,200). Link: https://billing.internal/reports/invoice/85432-R1

billing-bot: Credit memo CM-2026-0581 created for $500 (goodwill, to be applied to next invoice). Memo flagged for next billing cycle with note: "Apply to next invoice for Skyline-APAC; reason MISAPPLIED_PROMO_SPLIT_TKT-7788".

lucas_billing: emailed CM-2026-0580 and notification about CM-2026-0581 to the customer and copied AE and CS. Logged GL entries and put the goodwill memo into the next-cycle queue.

kevin_fin: thanks everyone. filing a short retro: sales must confirm promo account vs subaccount 48h before cutoff. adding to playbook and tagging @sales-ops. closing ticket once Skyline ACKs. :memo:
